answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of agents for a compute heartbeat: each must mirror its workload and prove real work within 60 seconds. A pass earns a pearl, a reputation token; three pearls unlock full earnings. Faking 100 identities means keeping 100 compute sessions hot, about $0.40 each per day, $40 daily, while each fake earns under $0.10. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep their pearls, so faking costs far more than it returns.
